title: Bound for the noise operator on bounded functions
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $\rho\in[0,1]$, and let $f\colon\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ satisfy $|f(y)|\leq 1$ for every $y\in\{-1,1\}^n$. Then for every $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, $|T_\rho f(x)|\leq 1$, where $T_\rho$ multiplies each Walsh coefficient indexed by a set $S$ by $\rho^{|S|}$.
